turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Owen found out about the zero on his phone, in the middle of a class, and nobody called me first. I have until 4:40, Hale. Who decided that, and was Owen heard before it went in?
"Upset." That isn't an answer, Hale. Was Owen spoken to before that mark went in, yes or no?
But I'm not changing the grade.

"I'm not changing the grade." Then I'll be in the principal's office when we're done, with your own procedure in my hand, the one that says parents are contacted before any mark is entered. On what basis was that zero given?
I'm still not changing it. Keep going if you like.

"Keep going if you like." I'm writing that down, Hale, next to the fact that you still haven't told me what that zero rests on. If there's a document, show it to me now; if there isn't, I'm going to the principal's office the minute I leave this room.
You can say it ten more ways. The answer is no.

Then you'll give me one answer I haven't asked for yet, Hale. Is anything on Owen's record right now, and who else has seen this? Because the principal will be asking you both before the end of today.
